title: What's in a Caption? Dataset-Specific Linguistic Diversity and Its Effect on Visual Description Models and Metrics

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating token and n-gram level linguistic diversity using metrics such as Effective Vocab Size (EVS-N) and Expected Decisions (ED@N) to demonstrate how datasets bias models toward generating generic, semantically redundant captions and exploiting n-gram metrics.

Measuring the conceptual overlap between visual description dataset ground truths and the label sets of common pre-training datasets (e.g., ImageNet, Kinetics, COCO, Places) using string matching to assess whether models are biased towards visual classification based on pre-trained features rather than actual language generation.
